tools.name: get_health
tools.title: Health check
tools.description: Liveness probe of the StreamHub core (GET /api/v1/health). Public endpoint — a quick way to verify the base URL is right.

tools.name: get_system_stats
tools.title: Server stats
tools.description: Global server statistics: apps, live streams, system resources (GET /api/v1/stats).

tools.name: query_logs
tools.title: Query server logs
tools.description: Query the server logs with filters (GET /api/v1/logs). Useful for diagnosing ingest/recording problems; filter by app to scope to one app.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List the apps (tenant-scoped multi-tenant units) visible to the token (GET /api/v1/apps).

tools.name: get_app
tools.title: Get app
tools.description: Get one app by slug, with its resolved config (GET /api/v1/apps/{name}).

tools.name: create_app
tools.title: Create app
tools.description: Create a new app: scaffolds directories, config.yaml, per-app DB and sample pages (POST /api/v1/apps).

roomPrefix.description: LiveKit room prefix (defaults to the slug).

tools.name: update_app
tools.title: Update app config
tools.description: Patch an app's config.yaml — display name, recording, callbacks (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{name}). Returns the merged resolved config.

splitMinutes.description: Split recordings into N-minute MP4 parts (0/15/30/60/90/120; 0 = single file).

snapshotSeconds.description: JPEG snapshot every N seconds while recording (0/1/30/60/120/360; 0 = off).

filenameTemplate.description: Filename/S3-key template for recordings (${} dialect: ${app} ${streamId} ${room} ${type} ${ts} ${date:yyyy-MM-dd} ${var.NAME}). Empty = built-in naming.

snapshotTemplate.description: Filename/S3-key template for snapshots (same ${} dialect; ${type} = jpg). Empty = built-in naming.

retentionDays.description: VOD retention window in days (0/7/30/90/180/360; 0 = keep forever). A periodic janitor deletes VODs older than this from the app DB AND its S3 storage.

variables.description: Per-app plain-config variables (WHOLE-MAP REPLACE — send the full desired set), referenced from filename/snapshot templates as ${var.NAME}. Keys must be [A-Za-z0-9_]. NOT secrets.

callbackSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign callbacks.

tools.name: get_app_stats
tools.title: App stats
tools.description: Per-app stats: live streams/viewers, VOD counts/storage, ingress and a 24h log rollup (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/stats).

tools.name: get_app_sizes
tools.title: App storage footprint
tools.description: This app's storage footprint: app.db size + total VOD bytes (GET /api/v1/apps/{name}/sizes).

tools.name: delete_app
tools.title: Delete app (DESTRUCTIVE)
tools.description: Permanently delete an app, optionally purging its VODs and local files (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{name}). DESTRUCTIVE — requires explicit user confirmation.

deleteVods.description: Also purge the app VODs/local files.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Only pass it after the user has EXPLICITLY approved this destructive operation in the conversation.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.title: List config presets
tools.description: List the built-in declarative delivery/quality profiles (low-latency / high-quality-recording / mass-audience-HLS / rtmp-passthrough) with what each one sets, and whether it is currently `applied` to the app (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/presets).

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.title: Apply config preset
tools.description: Deep-merge a preset's partial config over the app's config.yaml, take a timestamped backup, write it and hot-reload the app in place — no process restart, no cut streams (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/presets/{preset}/apply). Returns the diff.

tools.name: deactivate_preset
tools.title: Deactivate config preset
tools.description: Revert a preset's keys to their factory defaults (or remove forward-looking keys with no default), backup + hot-reload (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/presets/{preset}/deactivate). Returns the diff.

tools.name: list_streams
tools.title: List live streams
tools.description: List the active streams of an app (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams).

tools.name: get_stream
tools.title: Get stream
tools.description: Detail of one active stream, including viewers (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}). Stream ids may contain "/" — pass them verbatim, encoding is handled.

tools.name: stop_stream
tools.title: Stop stream
tools.description: Stop a live stream (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}). This interrupts a live broadcast — use only when the user asked for it.

tools.name: snapshot_stream
tools.title: On-demand snapshot (by stream id)
tools.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot right now, by stream id — works for LiveKit-backed streams (room composite) AND passthrough/HLS streams (latest on-disk HLS segment) (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}/snapshot). Returns { key, url }; fires stream.snapshot. 503 when there is no live source.

tools.name: snapshot_room
tools.title: On-demand snapshot (by room)
tools.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot right now, by room name (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/snapshots). Returns { key, url }; fires stream.snapshot. Prefer snapshot_stream when you already know the stream id.

participantIdentity.description: Snapshot one participant instead of the room composite.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.title: List live rooms
tools.description: List the app's live rooms with participant counts and metadata (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms).

tools.name: get_room
tools.title: Get live room
tools.description: One live room with its metadata; 404 if not currently active (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}).

tools.name: list_participants
tools.title: List room participants
tools.description: The room's participants with their published tracks (sids) and grants — feeds the moderation actions (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}/participants).

tools.name: kick_participant
tools.title: Kick participant
tools.description: Remove a participant from a live room (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}/participants/{identity}). Moderation action — use on user request.

tools.name: mute_participant
tools.title: Mute/unmute participant
tools.description: Server-side mute/unmute of a participant's published tracks (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}/participants/{identity}/mute). Pass trackSid, or kind audio|video|all.

trackSid.description: Specific track sid; omit to select by kind.

tools.name: update_room_metadata
tools.title: Update room metadata
tools.description: Set a live room's metadata; connected clients receive roomMetadataChanged (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}/metadata).

tools.name: send_room_data
tools.title: Send data message to room
tools.description: Push a server-side data message (chat/reaction/custom) to every subscriber of a room (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/rooms/{room}/data).

topic.description: Data topic; "chat"/"reaction" map to the chat/reaction callbacks.

payload.description: Raw payload; when omitted an envelope is built.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the app's tags — small operator-created entities with a settings blob, applied to streams/rooms (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags). Optional kind filter.

tools.name: get_tag
tools.title: Get tag
tools.description: One tag by slug (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags/{slug}). 404 if absent.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.title: Create tag
tools.description: Create a tag entity — a settings blob consumers (e.g. Vision Edge) read per-model config from (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags). 409 on a duplicate slug, 400 on a malformed slug.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case reference stored on streams, e.g. "store-downtown".

config_json.description: Settings blob owned by the tag's consumer.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.title: Update tag
tools.description: Update a tag's label/kind/config_json — slug is immutable (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags/{slug}).

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.title: Delete tag
tools.description: Delete a tag and prune its slug from every stream that referenced it, in one transaction (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags/{slug}).

tools.name: apply_room_tags
tools.title: Apply tags to a room
tools.description: Replace the tag slugs applied to every stream row of a room (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{app}/tags/room/{room}). Every slug must reference an existing tag (400 otherwise).

tags.description: Tag slugs to apply (must all exist).

tools.name: get_stream_tags
tools.title: Get stream tags
tools.description: A stream's applied tag slugs (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}/tags).

tools.name: update_stream_tags
tools.title: Set stream tags
tools.description: Replace a stream's applied tag slugs — every slug must reference an existing tag, 400 otherwise (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}/tags).

tags.description: Tag slugs to apply (must all exist).

tools.name: create_ingress
tools.title: Create ingress (get RTMP URL + key)
tools.description: Create an ingress for an app room (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/ingress). inputType "rtmp" returns the RTMP push URL + stream key for OBS/encoders (optionally a failover pair with backup:true); "whip" returns a WHIP endpoint; "url" pulls a remote RTSP/HLS/MP4/SRT source into the room; "srt" is a PUSH passthrough endpoint (mode must be "passthrough") returning srt_url; "mpegts" is a PULL passthrough of a UDP unicast/multicast MPEG-TS source (mode must be "passthrough", url like "udp://@GROUP:PORT").

inputType.description: rtmp = push URL+key; whip = WHIP endpoint; url = pull a remote source; srt = SRT push passthrough; mpegts = UDP unicast/multicast MPEG-TS pull passthrough.

mode.description: REQUIRED "passthrough" for inputType srt/mpegts (LiveKit has no native input for either).

room.description: Destination room (namespaced under the app prefix if not already).

url.description: Required for inputType "url" (remote RTSP/HLS/MP4/SRT source) or "mpegts" (udp://@GROUP:PORT — group must be 224.0.0.0/4 for multicast).

sources.description: mpegts only: comma-separated source-IP allow-list for SSM/IGMPv3 multicast.

localaddr.description: mpegts only: local NIC IPv4 to bind/join the multicast group on.

fifoSize.description: mpegts only: ffmpeg fifo_size in 188-byte packet units (default 28672).

overrunNonfatal.description: mpegts only: survive a UDP buffer overrun instead of aborting (default true).

enableTranscoding.description: Server-side multi-layer transcoding (defaults from app config).

backup.description: rtmp only: also mint a second failover stream key bound to the same room.

tools.name: list_ingress
tools.title: List ingresses
tools.description: Paginated list of the app ingresses with live state (status/bitrate/viewers) AND the ingest credentials rtmp_url + stream_key (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/ingress).

tools.name: get_ingress
tools.title: Get ingress
tools.description: One ingress by id, with credentials and state (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/ingress/{id}).

tools.name: delete_ingress
tools.title: Delete ingress
tools.description: Delete an ingress endpoint — its stream key stops working immediately (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/ingress/{id}).

tools.name: start_recording
tools.title: Start recording (room)
tools.description: Start a recording egress for a room (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/recording/start). recordMode: composite (default, room render) | track (one publisher, no Chrome) | audio (audio-only).

streamId.description: Logical stream id; in track/audio modes doubles as the participant identity.

participantIdentity.description: Publisher identity for track/audio modes (defaults to streamId).

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.title: Stop recording
tools.description: Stop an in-progress recording by its egress/recording id (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/recording/{id}/stop).

tools.name: start_stream_recording
tools.title: Start recording (live stream)
tools.description: Start recording an already-live stream by its stream id (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}/record/start).

tools.name: stop_stream_recording
tools.title: Stop recording (live stream)
tools.description: Stop the in-progress recording of a live stream (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/streams/{id}/record/stop).

tools.name: list_vods
tools.title: List VODs
tools.description: List the app VODs with filters, ordering and paging (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/vods).

tools.name: get_vod
tools.title: Get VOD
tools.description: VOD detail with playback URLs (url/presignedUrl/publicUrl) plus adaptive/HLS variants when available (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/vods/{id}).

tools.name: transcribe_vod
tools.title: Transcribe VOD
tools.description: Trigger (or re-run) speech-to-text transcription of a ready VOD; requires the "transcription" plugin installed + enabled. Asynchronous — poll get_vod_transcript for status (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/vods/{id}/transcribe).

tools.name: get_vod_transcript
tools.title: Get VOD transcript
tools.description: A VOD's transcript: status (queued|processing|ready|failed), full text, timed segments with speakers, and the SRT subtitle (srtKey + presigned srtUrl) (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/vods/{id}/transcript). 404 if never transcribed.

tools.name: delete_vod
tools.title: Delete VOD (DESTRUCTIVE)
tools.description: Permanently delete a VOD with full cascade: DB row + S3 object + snapshot + local file (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/vods/{id}). DESTRUCTIVE — requires explicit user confirmation.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Only pass it after the user has EXPLICITLY approved this destructive operation in the conversation.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.title: List plugins (marketplace)
tools.description: Marketplace view: every built-in plugin plus this app's install/enable/config state (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins).

tools.name: get_plugin
tools.title: Get plugin
tools.description: One marketplace entry: manifest, configSchema and install state (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}).

tools.name: install_plugin
tools.title: Install plugin
tools.description: Install a built-in plugin into the app; idempotent (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}/install).

tools.name: configure_plugin
tools.title: Enable/disable/configure plugin
tools.description: Enable/disable an installed plugin and/or patch its config; config keys are validated against the plugin configSchema (PATCH /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}).

tools.name: uninstall_plugin
tools.title: Uninstall plugin
tools.description: Uninstall a plugin from the app — stops its worker and clears live-data feeds; its config is lost (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}).

tools.name: control_plugin_worker
tools.title: Plugin worker control
tools.description: Start/stop/inspect the worker process of a needsWorker plugin (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}/worker/start | /worker/stop, GET /worker/status).

action.description: What to do with the worker.

tools.name: get_plugin_logs
tools.title: Plugin logs
tools.description: Per-plugin logs: worker output + persisted plugin log lines (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/{id}/logs).

tools.name: list_live_control_streams
tools.title: List live-control streams
tools.description: Live streams of the app with their pause/resume/finish control state (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/streams).

tools.name: get_live_control_stream
tools.title: Get live-control state
tools.description: One stream and its control state (state/since/cover) (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/streams/{streamId}).

tools.name: pause_live_stream
tools.title: Pause live stream
tools.description: Pause a live stream: viewers see a cover (image/video/text card), audio muted server-side. Interrupts what viewers see — use only when the user asked for it (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/streams/{streamId}/pause). Fires livecontrol.paused.

tools.name: resume_live_stream
tools.title: Resume live stream
tools.description: Resume a paused live stream — unmutes and clears the cover (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/streams/{streamId}/resume). Fires livecontrol.resumed.

tools.name: finish_live_stream
tools.title: Finish live stream (with cover)
tools.description: Finish a live stream showing a final card/asset cover — a stronger, terminal version of pause. Use only when the user asked for it (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/streams/{streamId}/finish). Fires livecontrol.finished.

tools.name: list_live_control_assets
tools.title: List live-control cover assets
tools.description: Uploaded cover assets (images/videos) with signed preview URLs (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/assets). Uploading a new asset is a multipart file upload, not exposed over MCP — use the dashboard.

tools.name: get_live_control_asset_url
tools.title: Get live-control asset URL
tools.description: A fresh signed preview URL for one cover asset (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/assets/{id}/url).

tools.name: delete_live_control_asset
tools.title: Delete live-control asset
tools.description: Delete a cover asset — DB row + S3 object (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/assets/{id}).

tools.name: get_live_control_settings
tools.title: Get live-control settings
tools.description: The app's live-control defaults: default cover mode/card, mute-on-pause, poll interval, default pause/finish asset ids (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/settings).

tools.name: set_live_control_settings
tools.title: Set live-control default assets
tools.description: Set the default pause/finish cover assets used when a call omits an override; pass null to clear (PUT /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/live-control/settings).

defaultPauseAssetId.description: Default pause cover asset id, or null to clear.

defaultFinishAssetId.description: Default finish cover asset id, or null to clear.

tools.name: get_stream_health_overview
tools.title: Stream health overview
tools.description: Health events today + rooms with recent history/threshold overrides (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/stream-health/overview).

tools.name: list_stream_health_events
tools.title: List stream health events
tools.description: Recent health.* transitions (e.g. audio_lost, av_desync, stalled, degraded, recovered) from stream-health.db (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/stream-health/events).

tools.name: get_stream_health_room_settings
tools.title: Get per-room health thresholds
tools.description: A room's threshold override plus the resolved effective thresholds (defaults ⊕ install config ⊕ override) (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/stream-health/streams/{room}/settings).

tools.name: set_stream_health_room_settings
tools.title: Set per-room health thresholds
tools.description: Set a PARTIAL per-room threshold override — only pass the fields you want to change; omit a field to keep its current value/default, pass no fields at all to clear the override entirely. Picked up live by the worker, no restart (PUT /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/stream-health/streams/{room}/settings).

bitrate_drop_pct.description: % below rolling baseline counted as degraded; 0 = off (default 50).

recover_samples.description: Consecutive clean samples required before health.recovered (default 2).

tools.name: list_streamflow_events
tools.title: Streamflow event catalogue
tools.description: The catalogue of known trigger events by family (room/stream/plugin/etc.), for building workflow triggers (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/events).

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.title: List Streamflow workflows
tools.description: The app's Streamflow automation workflows (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows).

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.title: Get Streamflow workflow
tools.description: One workflow with its graph (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}).

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.title: Create Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Create an automation workflow: a graph of trigger/condition/action boxes (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows). Use list_streamflow_events for trigger names and the dashboard box palette for box types — graph shape is { boxes:[{id,type,config}], edges:[{from,fromPort?,to}] }.

tools.name: update_workflow
tools.title: Update Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Update a workflow's name/enabled/graph (PUT /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}).

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.title: Delete Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Delete a workflow and its run history (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}).

tools.name: enable_workflow
tools.title: Enable/disable Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Enable or disable a workflow (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}/enable).

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.title: Run Streamflow workflow manually
tools.description: Trigger a manual run of a workflow with an optional payload injected as the trigger context (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}/run).

payload.description: Injected as context.trigger for this run.

tools.name: export_workflow
tools.title: Export Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Export a workflow as portable, secret-safe JSON ({ streamflow, name, graph, redactions? }) — config paths that looked like secrets are redacted, never exported with values (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/{id}/export).

tools.name: import_workflow
tools.title: Import Streamflow workflow
tools.description: Import a workflow from portable JSON (validated against the box catalogue; unknown box types are rejected) (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/workflows/import).

workflow.description: Portable workflow JSON: { streamflow, name, graph }.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.title: List Streamflow runs
tools.description: Recent workflow runs, optionally filtered by workflow (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/runs).

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.title: Get Streamflow run
tools.description: One run with its per-box steps (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/runs/{id}).

tools.name: list_streamflow_secrets
tools.title: List Streamflow secrets (masked)
tools.description: Secret NAMES + a masked hint (e.g. "sk-…a1b2") for this app's Streamflow secrets — values are NEVER returned by any endpoint (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/secrets).

tools.name: put_streamflow_secret
tools.title: Create/replace Streamflow secret
tools.description: Create or replace a Streamflow secret value, encrypted at rest — referenced from workflow box configs as {{secret.NAME}}. The value is write-only: this call returns only masked metadata, never the value back (PUT /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/secrets/{name}).

value.description: Secret plaintext value to encrypt and store.

tools.name: delete_streamflow_secret
tools.title: Delete Streamflow secret
tools.description: Delete a Streamflow secret by name (DELETE /api/v1/apps/{app}/plugins/streamflow/secrets/{name}).

tools.name: mint_join_token
tools.title: Mint LiveKit join token
tools.description: Mint a LiveKit join token for an app room, returning the token plus public player/iframe URLs (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/tokens). Use canPublish=false for viewer-only tokens.

room.description: Room (namespaced under the app prefix; defaults to it).

hidden.description: Hidden participant (QC/recorder), not counted as viewer.

tools.name: sign_playback_url
tools.title: Sign playback URL / mint embed
tools.description: Mint a signed short-TTL playback capability for a room — required for apps with publicPlayback disabled (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/play-token/{room}/sign). Default TTL 300s (30s-24h). Returns tokenUrl (raw API), playUrl (SPA player), embedUrl (SPA embed) and a ready-made iframe snippet — use embedUrl/iframe to embed the stream on a third-party page.

tools.name: list_api_tokens
tools.title: List API tokens
tools.description: List the sk_ API tokens visible to the caller — hashes never returned (GET /api/v1/tokens).

tools.name: create_api_token
tools.title: Create API token
tools.description: Create a new sk_ API token; the plaintext is returned ONCE — relay it to the user immediately (POST /api/v1/tokens). Prefer scope "app" over "global".

tools.name: revoke_api_token
tools.title: Revoke API token
tools.description: Revoke (soft-delete) an sk_ API token by id — integrations using it stop working (DELETE /api/v1/tokens/{id}).

tools.name: get_app_db_health
tools.title: App DB health
tools.description: Health of the per-app SQLite DB: size, WAL, fragmentation, per-table rows (GET /api/v1/apps/{app}/db/health).

tools.name: purge_app_db
tools.title: Purge app data (DESTRUCTIVE)
tools.description: Purge app data by scope: 'vods' (cascades to S3 + local files), 'logs', or 'all' app-scoped data — the app and its config survive (POST /api/v1/apps/{app}/db/purge). DESTRUCTIVE — requires explicit user confirmation.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Only pass it after the user has EXPLICITLY approved this destructive operation in the conversation.

resources.name: apps
resources.title: StreamHub apps
resources.description: The list of apps (multi-tenant units) visible to the configured token.

resources.name: health
resources.title: StreamHub health
resources.description: Liveness of the configured StreamHub instance.

resourceTemplates.name: app
resourceTemplates.title: StreamHub app detail
resourceTemplates.description: One app by slug, with its resolved configuration.

prompts.name: go-live
prompts.title: How to go live
prompts.description: Step-by-step runbook to put a stream on air in a StreamHub app (RTMP ingest via OBS or any encoder) and share playback.

arguments.name: app
arguments.description: App slug to go live in.

arguments.name: room
arguments.description: Room name (defaults to the app room prefix).

prompts.name: diagnose-stream
prompts.title: Diagnose a stream
prompts.description: Investigate why a stream is not working: ingress state, live rooms, app stats and error logs.
